title: Class Activity Budget Recorder
goal: Verify the amount input, accumulate each expenditure by points, and calculate the balance.
summary: class activities are available for 300 yuan. After each accounting, the page should update the expenditure and balance so that the overspending amount can be easily seen.
tasks: Add role="alert" to #expense-error in index.html so that input prompts can be perceived by assistive technologies.
Make .expense-summary into two columns of equal width in style.css, with a column spacing of 12px.

Check the validity of the input box before recording the amount. Blanks, non-positive numbers, and amounts with more than two decimal places are rejected and display "Please enter an amount greater than 0 and with up to two decimal places.".

passes the verification, the amount will be recorded in points. Add up all expenses, subtract expenses from budget, and display both amounts to two decimal places. Keep a negative balance when you overspend.

example.note: The ticket amount is first accumulated in integer points, and finally converted into yuan and displayed using toFixed(2).

hint: When the input is illegal, return immediately after the prompt. Only updating the error message but continuing to execute the following code will add the error value to the expenditure.
